supportingSources.label: Stern Ali operation and service manual
Steven Bowden at PAPA Circuit Final 2012-13

strategy.summary: Complete the top-left three-bank until the held Bonus X reaches 5x. Each target and rollover hit adds 2,000 to Bonus Score. Then repeat the right-side eject pocket, which collects Bonus Score × Bonus X without resetting either value.

steps.text: From the right flipper, complete the top-left three-bank until Bonus X reaches 5x.
modeNotes: Bonus X: Four bank completions reach 5x in three-ball play; five completions reach 5x in five-ball play. Bonus X carries between balls and survives a tilt.

steps.text: While working the bank, use standups, return lanes, and center rollovers; each hit adds 2,000 to Bonus Score.
modeNotes: Bonus Score: It starts at 2,000, advances by 2,000, and tops out at 28,000. A full 5x collect scores 140,000.

steps.text: At 5x, move the ball to the left flipper and shoot the right-side Collect Bonus eject pocket.
modeNotes: Collect Bonus: The eject pocket scores Bonus Score × Bonus X. It does not reset either value.

steps.text: Control the eject-pocket kickout and return the ball to the left flipper with the feed that works on this copy: a cradle and post pass, a tip to the left flipper, or a dead bounce.
Repeat the right-side eject pocket while its kickout remains controlled.

fallback.title: Left three-bank
fallback.when: Use this when the right-side eject-pocket kickout cannot be returned to the left flipper.

steps.text: From the right flipper, complete the left three-bank.
modeNotes: Left-bank value: A completion scores the lit star value once, plus that value again for each G-R-E-A-T-E-S-T letter already lit.

steps.text: Repeat the bank as its star value rises from 4,000 to 6,000, 8,000, then 10,000. A scrape across the bank can hit several targets and rebound into the top-left bank.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete the top-left three-bank four times in three-ball play or five times in five-ball play to reach 5x. Bonus X carries between balls and survives a tilt.

quickInfo.name: Bonus Score
quickInfo.summary: Standups, return lanes, and center rollovers raise it by 2,000, from a 2,000 start to a 28,000 maximum.

quickInfo.name: Collect Bonus
quickInfo.summary: The right-side eject pocket scores Bonus Score × Bonus X without resetting either value. A maximum collect is 140,000.

quickInfo.name: Left three-bank
quickInfo.summary: A completion scores the current 4,000-to-10,000 star value once, plus once for every G-R-E-A-T-E-S-T letter already lit.

noteDetails.label: Top-player proof
items: At the 2012-13 PAPA Circuit Final, Cayle George and Daniele Acciari built the held Bonus X and repeatedly collected the multiplied Bonus Score at the right eject pocket.
Acciari used an on-the-fly collect to take the lead.
At the UK Open 2023 Classics I final, Raymond Davidson built 3x Bonus and collected the multiplied bonus at the right eject pocket
Peter Andersen and Julio Vicario Soriano also developed Bonus X before attempting the same collect.
Original Stern six-digit ROM. The seven-digit alib revision 76 and alic revision 85 are separate code revisions.

checkBeforePlay: Test the right-side eject-pocket kickout before Bonus Score is large; learn whether a cradle, tip, or dead bounce returns the ball to the left flipper.
Test the top-left and left three-banks from their intended flippers and watch the far-right bumper exit toward the outlane.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Cradle on the left flipper. Test a backhand into the top-left three-bank. Use it only when this copy clears the targets cleanly.

techniques.name: Left-bank scrape
techniques.instruction: From the right flipper, scrape across the left bank. A clean line can clear more than one target and deflect into the upper Bonus X bank.

techniques.name: Eject-pocket transfer
techniques.instruction: Test the right-side eject-pocket kickout once. Use a cradle and post pass, a tip, or a dead bounce only when it reliably returns the ball to the left flipper.

cautions.issue: The Collect Bonus eject-pocket kickout decides whether the main route is repeatable.
cautions.response: Learn the feed before the bonus is large. Use the left-bank fallback when the return cannot be controlled.

cautions.issue: The upper-left turnaround can continue toward a drain.
cautions.response: Stop using the spinner when a full shot leaves the return uncontrolled.

cautions.issue: Target rebounds and bumper exits can feed either outlane.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready after bank shots. Watch the far-right bumper exit until the ball clears the right outlane.

strategy.simpleOverview: In Ali, each completion of the top-left three-bank raises Bonus X until it reaches 5x. Standups, return lanes, and center rollovers each add 2,000 to Bonus Score. At 5x, repeat the right-side Collect Bonus eject pocket from the left flipper; the collect does not reset either value.

At 5x, shoot the right-side Collect Bonus eject pocket from the left flipper, control its kickout, and repeat it because neither Bonus Score nor Bonus X resets.
